correctness.rationale: Unisolvent F_omega uniquely fixes D. Its off-center interior Lagrange cardinal gives D_11=omega sin(omega a)/(cos omega-cos omega a), so diagonal positive P and zero middle SBP boundary force a=0. The centered exact D and P are derived and verified symbolically, with positivity iff 0<omega<2pi/3. Differentiation of the explicit H proves strict mass defect; series and endpoint asymptotics were symbolically checked. The embedded checker passed 668 exact/seeded tests; tests do not prove continuum claims.

value.rationale: The smallest nodal trigonometric FSBP discretization with two endpoints has a natural exact design question. The complete rigid node-geometry/frequency characterization determines when a positive energy norm exists. The strictly enlarged norm mass, its Simpson-limit scale and sharp blowup identify an intrinsic incompatibility between exact trigonometric differentiation, positive diagonal SBP, and exact physical constant mass in this minimal family; these are useful analytic design constraints, not merely a sample calculation.
